This Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) is made between Brightco Ltd (“Client”) and Harbour Studio (“Studio”).
1. Services. The Studio will design and build the Client's new website as described in the attached proposal, including two rounds of revisions.
2. Timeline. Work starts on 1 December 2026. The Studio will deliver the finished site by 14 February 2027.
3. Fees. The Client will pay $24,000 in three instalments: 40% on signing, 30% at the design sign-off and 30% on launch.
4. Ownership. Once paid in full, the Client owns the final designs and code.
5. Confidentiality. Both parties keep the other's private information private, during and after this Agreement.
6. Ending the Agreement. Either party can end this Agreement with 30 days' written notice. Work done until then is paid for.
7. Entire agreement. This document is the whole agreement between the parties and replaces earlier discussions.
Signed by the parties on the dates below.
